title: Winter Practice Period Shuso's Class - Continuing Our Maturity Part 5
speaker: Shin-yu Scott Allen
summary: Shin-yu Scott Allen takes up Chapter 8 and the afterword of the book the class has been reading, on conduct and the precepts. Shin-yu recalls a military review of a reckless young lieutenant, where no ethical guidance could be found, then asks the room why people delay resolving their mistakes, comparing rumination to a record played with a bad needle. A walk through the triple treasure, the three pure precepts, and the ten grave precepts follows, with examples such as a lie that grows longer with each excuse and a wife who yells at the evening news. The class closes with a passage on the mature self and Shin-yu's joy in passing lessons on to others.
